title: Can I FIRMLY GRASP Drawback Chess?
summary: Tony plays online Drawback Chess (each player gets a random secret handicap; king-capture rules) at a 1+2 bullet control against random humans, refusing to stop until he has 10 wins (after being put on ViperKing's 'wall of shame'). He sees his OWN drawback at game start; the opponent's is revealed after the game. He wins 10 games, many on time.
rules: Each player is assigned one random drawback at game start; you see your own, the opponent's is hidden (revealed at game end).
King-capture rules: there is no check/checkmate; you win by capturing the king (moving into check is legal), or when the opponent violates/loses by their drawback (some drawbacks say 'or lose').
Time control 1+2 (1 s base? — 'one second base time, two seconds back per move' as stated; likely 1 minute + 2 s).

Drawbacks seen (own): Superstitious — can't move to a square your opponent has captured on. Bottled Lightning — if you can move your king, you must. Eat Your Veggies — can't capture non-pawns until opponent has only four pawns. Relay Race — if you can move a piece adjacent to the destination of your last move, you must. Snipers — bishops can only capture from a distance of at least four diagonal squares. Truant — can't move the same piece twice in a row. Going the Distance — must move at least as far as opponent's last move or lose. Death Wish — if you can move your king into check (and aren't in check), you must. Alternating — must alternate between pawn moves and piece moves. Undefended — you lose if you have an undefended pawn. Pacman — if you can capture a pawn, you must (frame card).

Drawbacks seen (opponents): Outflanked — except for capturing kings, can't capture on the rim. Hipster — can't move the same piece type as opponent's last move. Secret Garden — a hidden garden square in front of your pawns: you can't move onto it, and if your opponent tramples it you lose. Stop Stalling — pieces cannot move laterally. Turn the Other Cheek — cannot recapture. Hedonic Treadmill — must move a piece at least as valuable as opponent's last-moved piece. Gorilla Tactics — after a capture you must return the capturing piece to its previous square if possible. Winds of Fate — each turn you are randomly unable to move either left or right. Botvinnik's Gambit — at the start of turn 11 you must not have a queen and your opponent must have one.
win_condition: Capture the opponent's king, flag them, or have them lose by their drawback; meta goal 10 wins.
